newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria declares Trade and Savings Bank insolvent.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria declares Trade and Savings Bank insolvent.

text.p: The Sofia City Court on Thursday declared the private Trade and Savings Bank (TSBank) insolvent at the request of the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB), a court official said.
TSB can appeal against the ruling.
"The court ruled the bank insolvent from September 23, 1996 and appointed a liquidator," the official told reporters.

The BNB put TSBank in receivership on September 23 due to a danger of insolvency, dismissed its management and appointed sequestrators to establish its financial state. A bankruptcy procedure for TSBank was launched at end-October.
TSBank had outstanding payments worth 4.77 billion levs as of September 20, the BNB said. @

TSBank was the fourth bank ruled insolvent by the courts out of a total of 16 local private and state banks or one third of Bulgaria's banks whose insolvency has been sought by the BNB since May 1996.
The other three were the private Crystalbank, Private Agricultural and Investment Bank and state-owned Mineralbank.

Under a memorandum of economic policies agreed with the International Monetary Fund in March Bulgaria has pledged to approve a new Bank Insolvency Law to facilitate more efficient resolution of cases against banks which the BNB has sought to close down.
